snippet.title: FILE 13 – "Are You Awake?" | Psychological Horror Teaser
snippet.description:
FILE 13 – "Are You Awake?" | Psychological Horror Teaser

It's 3:17 AM. A stranger named Mariam messages you. She needs a deleted file recovered.
Then an unknown number texts you: "This is not her."

💬 Join the Discord for news and playtests: 
https://discord.gg/rZPySh9awz
🕹️ Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5527560/FILE_13/

FILE 13 is a psychological horror game that takes place entirely on one computer. You're a freelance data-recovery tech in Cairo, taking small jobs for small money, until one client starts asking questions no client should. Dig through deleted files, broken photos and people's messages. The deeper you go, the more the machine seems to know about you.

▸ A full fake desktop to explore: messages, a browser, a terminal, forensics tools
▸ Every job is its own mini-game, and some jobs are scams
▸ A story told across multiple chapters, where your choices lead to different endings
▸ Voiced characters, voice notes, and phone calls you really shouldn't make
▸ Fully playable in English and Egyptian Arabic

Some files are deleted for a reason.

—
AI disclosure: most character voices and character images in FILE 13 are AI-generated. Two characters, Pisty and Youssef Khaled, are played by real people.

#FILE13 #HorrorGame #PsychologicalHorror #IndieHorror
